code:
Utilization (U) = total borrowed / total supplied

Pool: 800,000 USDC borrowed out of 1,000,000 USDC supplied
U = 800,000 / 1,000,000 = 0.80 (80%)
caption: High utilization = little capital left for the next borrower or withdrawal.

code:
Borrow rate, kinked model (illustrative):
  base rate:         0%
  slope 1 (U < 80%):  0% -> 4%   as U goes 0% -> 80%
  kink (optimal U):  80%
  slope 2 (U > 80%):  4% -> 75%  as U goes 80% -> 100%

At U=50%: ~2.5%   At U=80%: 4%   At U=95%: ~42.25%
caption: Gentle below the kink, sharply steeper above it -- same curve, two regimes.

code:
Supply rate ≈ borrow rate * utilization * (1 - reserve factor)

At U = 80%, borrow rate = 4%, reserve factor = 10%:
  Supply rate ≈ 4% * 0.80 * 0.90 = 2.88%
caption: Borrowers pay the full rate; suppliers earn only a scaled share of it.

subtitle: What happens when a health factor drops below 1.0.
